About Machine Made Worlds

An English-language static blog that tracks how AI quietly rewires work, creativity and culture — essays first, hype last.

Why this exists

The web is flooded with AI content. Most of it is rushed, generic or optimized for clicks. Machine Made Worlds is the opposite: slow, sourced, and built to last. Each piece aims to be useful in six months, not six hours.

What we cover

  • Essays — how automation changes jobs, cities and taste.
  • Guides — practical playbooks you can run this week.
  • Field notes — tiny observations from building with models.

How the site is built

Static HTML + CSS, no build step, no trackers, no heavy frameworks. Light-first with a matching dark mode, dist/ is the deploy artifact mirrored to Hostinger public_html. Every publish needs Board approval. Fast by design:

dist/
  index.html
  about/index.html
  blog/index.html
  posts/<slug>/index.html
  styles.css
  sitemap.xml
  robots.txt
  404.html
Fast sites respect readers' time and battery. We ship under 20KB of CSS, zero webfonts and a sub-1KB theme script.

Editorial standards

All articles are in English, fact-checked and link to sources. We disclose AI assistance when used. No listicles for SEO, no affiliate clutter.

Contact

Reach us at hello@machinemadeworlds.com — or open an issue on our content calendar once it's public.

Want to collaborate? We're hiring lean: writer, frontend builder, QA/SEO and deploy specialists. Board approval required for publishing.
